visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands holds up a beige Rakuten Monkeys baseball jersey against a neutral grey wall. The jersey features black and red text and various embroidered patches depicting monkeys and baseball gear. The camera pans from the front to the back, revealing the name 'GaLin' and the number '2' decorated with flower and character patches. (2) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a white knitted cardigan over a light green top and a beige baseball cap, appears on screen. She speaks with a lively expression, gesturing towards the camera while holding the jersey. The background is a brightly lit, clean indoor space. (3) The woman showcases a second jersey, this one with the name 'KIRA' and the number '19' on the back. She points out specific details on the sleeve, including a circular monkey patch and small heart and star decorations. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the fabric. (4) The woman is now at a DIY workstation inside a retail store. She carefully arranges small black letters and colorful patches onto a jersey laid flat on a table. She wears a denim-style baseball cap and a white graphic T-shirt. Background elements include retail shelves and a red handbag. (5) A fast-paced montage shows the technical process of creating the jerseys. Hands are seen placing patches onto the fabric and operating a professional heat press machine. The machine is black and heavy-duty, with a red handle being pulled down to seal the designs onto the shirts. (6) The main woman and another female companion with reddish hair stand in the middle of a brightly lit sports apparel store. They excitedly show off the finished 'LinDan' 00 jersey the main woman is wearing, pointing at the custom patches and logos. They then hold up matching customized tote bags featuring monkey designs and the number '3'. (7) The woman dances and twirls in the store aisle, holding two tote bags. She wears the beige jersey, a grey skirt, and the beige cap. Digital heart and sparkle animations overlay the frame as she moves, ending with her leaning toward the camera and sticking her tongue out playfully.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice describing a jersey. The background music is an upbeat, major-key acoustic pop track featuring rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming and a light piano melody at approximately 124 BPM. There is audible room tone consistent with an indoor setting and slight fabric rustling as garments are handled. (2) A sharp mechanical thud and hissing sound trigger a new phase, representing the operation of a heat press machine. The BGM shifts slightly in intensity, with a more pronounced percussive beat. The vocal density decreases momentarily to allow the machine sounds to take prominence. (3) The primary female voice returns, joined by a second female voice. They engage in overlapping chatter, laughter, and high-arousal exclamations like 'Wow!'. The BGM continues its cheerful acoustic theme. Several post-production sound effects, including 'bubble pops' and high-pitched 'dings', are layered over the conversation to emphasize visual cues. (4) The music swells in volume towards the end of the clip as the voices transition into cheers and playful shouting. The acoustic texture remains bright and sharp, with high spectral centroid brightness. The recording ends with a final cheerful exclamation and a quick fade of the music.
